title: Death of Deolane's Security Guard Causes Commotion on Social Media
seoTitle: Death of Deolane's Security Guard Causes Commotion Online
subtitle: Nego Jader was hospitalized in serious condition and passed away, with no cause of death released.
excerpt: Nego Jader, Deolane Bezerra's personal security guard, suffered a seizure, was hospitalized, and passed away on Wednesday, with his cause of death unrevealed.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Nego Jader, personal security guard to influencer Deolane Bezerra, suffered a seizure in the early hours of October 8th, was hospitalized in serious condition, and passed away on Wednesday, October 14th. The family disclosed updates on his condition and his death but did not release the final cause.

Nego Jader's Seizure and Hospitalization

In the early hours of the 8th, Nego Jader experienced a seizure and was rushed to an Emergency Care Unit (UPA) in Greater São Paulo. His condition was deemed serious, and he had to be intubated shortly after arriving at the hospital.

Reactions from Deolane's Family

Dayanne Bezerra, Deolane's sister, reported that the cause of his illness was unknown and mentioned the presence of fluid in his lungs. She stated that the family rented an ambulance with a mobile ICU to transfer the security guard to a private hospital. Kay Kay Bezerra, the influencer's son, used social media to communicate that Jader's condition was serious but stable, and asked for prayers from those who follow the family.

Clinical Condition and Treatment

On Monday, October 12th, Daniele Bezerra, another sister, reported that the infection had decreased, there was no fever, and the security guard was responding to antibiotic treatment. However, his kidneys remained compromised, requiring dialysis, and he continued to be intubated and receiving parenteral nutrition.

Nego Jader's Passing

Nego Jader's death was confirmed by Deolane's press office on Wednesday, October 14th. To date, no information regarding the cause of death has been released by the family or healthcare professionals.

Lack of Information Regarding Cause

The sources' reports do not provide conclusive details about what caused the seizure or the final cause of death. The family thanked the medical team and reiterated requests for prayers, without offering further clarification.

With information from Metrópoles, Portal UAI.
